authentication.description: When enabled, only authorized chat users can search this knowledge.

fileSizeLimit.label: Maximum size per uploaded document
fileSizeLimit.description: Set this limit according to your server capacity to avoid service crashes.

embeddingModel.changeConfirm: Changing the embedding requires regenerating embeddings for this knowledge. Continue saving

documentStrategy.title: Processing
documentStrategy.syncHint: New URLs found during knowledge sync are processed using this strategy. Changes take effect on the next sync.

smart.label: Smart splitting (recommended)
smart.description: Use smart splitting if you are unsure which rules to choose.

advanced.label: Advanced splitting
advanced.description: Choose delimiters, segment length, and cleanup rules to suit the document format.

delimiter.label: Segment delimiters
delimiter.description: The document is split recursively using the delimiters in the order you select. Segments longer than the configured length are truncated.

childChunkLength.label: Sub-chunk length
childChunkLength.description: Vector search uses these smaller chunks. When a chunk matches, the full segment is shown.

autoClean.label: Automatic cleanup
autoClean.description: (Remove redundant symbols, spaces, blank lines, and tabs)

visualEnhancement.label: Visual enhancement
visualEnhancement.description: Send images in the document to the selected model or tool and save its output as the image description.

titleAsQuestion.label: Index segment titles as questions
titleAsQuestion.description: Automatically add each segment title as a related question.
